function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH slc AS (
  SELECT
    s.period,
    c.channel,
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS qty,
    SUM(s.revenue_cad) AS revenue
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE s.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  GROUP BY s.period, c.channel, c.customer_id, c.customer_name
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM slc
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
  slc.period,
  slc.channel,
  slc.customer_id,
  slc.customer_name,
  slc.qty,
  slc.revenue,
  slc.qty / t.total_qty AS qty_share,
  slc.revenue / t.total_revenue AS revenue_share
FROM slc
JOIN totals t ON slc.period = t.period
ORDER BY slc.period, slc.channel, slc.customer_id","purpose":"Qty and revenue share by channel and customer for Aug and Sep 2026"}
